newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: FIEL revises Argentine industrial production down.
newsitem.headline: FIEL revises Argentine industrial production down.

text.p: Argentina's private consultancy FIEL Monday revised its March industrial output estimate to a 4.1 percent rise from the same period last year, down from a 5.8 increase it estimated last week.
FIEL also said it calculated a 7.8 percent industrial production growth in the first quarter.
FIEL's March estimate contrasted with an 8.0 percent growth announced by the government last week. The average by analysts surveyed by Reuters was for a 7.2 percent increase.
According to official preliminary figures, output in the first quarter was up 7.2 percent compared with the same period a year ago.
FIEL said the relatively low 4.1 percent increase in March was in part due to the Easter holiday which this year was in March instead of April.
But it pointed out that this was the fourth quarterly rise in a row.
